title: Stop Saying "Very Short"! 5 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very short". Try one of these instead:
• Brief: a brief phone call
• Quick: a quick lunch break
• Fleeting: a fleeting smile
• Momentary: a momentary silence
• Concise: a concise email

Which one will you use today? Write it in the comments.
